info.title: Suwappu Agent API
info.description:
Cross-chain DEX API for AI agents. Swap tokens across 7+ chains via structured endpoints.

## Errors
Errors come in two envelope shapes:

1. **Handler / validation errors** — `{ "success": false, "error": "...", "message": "...", "fields": {...} }`. Returned for validation failures (400), forbidden wallet ownership (403), and not-found resources (404) raised inside route handlers.
2. **Gateway errors** — `{ "error": "...", "requestId": "...", "timestamp": "..." }`. Returned by the global error handler for auth failures (401), rate limiting (429), and unhandled errors (500).

The `Error` component schema is permissive and covers both shapes; the per-operation examples show the exact body for that case.

## Rate limits
Authenticated endpoints are rate-limited per agent by tier (sliding 60s window): `free` = 30 req/min, `agent` = 100 req/min, `pro` = 500 req/min. Public endpoints are rate-limited per client IP. On 429 the response includes `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

example.error: wallet_address is not your managed wallet

Error.description: Standardized error body. Two shapes exist: handler/validation errors include `success: false` and `error` (and optionally `message`, `fields`, `hint`); gateway errors (auth/rate-limit/unhandled) include `error`, `requestId`, and `timestamp`. All fields are documented here; any given error uses the relevant subset.

message.example: Token not found: FOO on Base

fields.description: Per-field validation errors keyed by field path.

example.amount: amount must be a positive number

hint.description: Actionable hint for fixing the request.

service.description: Upstream service name on external-service errors.

example.message: amount must be a positive number

fields.amount: amount must be a positive number

PaymentChallenge.description: x402 payment-required challenge returned with HTTP 402 when metering is enabled and credits are insufficient.

id.description: Numeric chain id for EVM chains, or string id (e.g. "solana") for non-EVM.

TokenRef.description: Resolved token reference within a quote.

callback_url.description: Public HTTPS URL for webhook delivery. Private/metadata endpoints are rejected.

api_key.description: Save this — it cannot be retrieved later.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: At least one field must be provided.

from_token.description: Source token symbol (e.g. ETH, SOL, USDC).

chain.description: Chain key (e.g. base, solana). See GET /chains for the full list.

from_chain.description: Source chain key for cross-chain swaps.

to_chain.description: Destination chain key for cross-chain swaps.

wallet_address.description: EVM address (0x + 40 hex). When provided, the response includes executable transaction data.

Quote.description: Quote response. EVM (Li.Fi) and Solana (Jupiter) quotes share most fields; EVM quotes add chain ids and gas/bridge estimates, Solana quotes add `dex: Jupiter` and `requires_wallet`.

quote_id.description: Use with POST /swap or POST /swap/execute within 60s.

transaction.description: Present only when wallet_address was supplied (EVM).

wallet_address.description: Must be the agent's own managed wallet.

SwapTransaction.description: Unsigned transaction ready for signing. EVM returns a `transaction` object with calldata; Solana returns a base64 serialized transaction.

SwapStatusValue.description: Swap lifecycle status. Representative set; downstream values come from the swap pipeline.

command.description: Natural language command (e.g. "swap 0.5 ETH to USDC on Base").
command.example: swap 0.5 ETH to USDC on base

wallet_address.description: When provided, must be the agent's own managed wallet.

unknown_symbols.description: Symbols that could not be priced (present only when non-empty).

TokenList.description: When `chain` is provided: `chain`, `chain_id`, and a flat `tokens` array. When omitted: a `chains` array, each entry with its own `tokens`.

maxAmountWei.description: Required for spending_limit. Max value in wei.

chain.description: Chain the payment was made on.
